extraction.description: The screenshot shows UiPath Studio Web with a workflow activity selected on the canvas named "Send Rejection Email." The right-side configuration panel is open to the Implementation section, where the action is set to execute a connector activity using the Gmail connector. The Gmail connection is selected as uipathlabs@gmail.com and the activity is configured as Send Email.
extraction.step_instructions: Click on the Action dropdown and ensure "Execute connector activity" is selected. In the Connector field, select "Gmail". In the Gmail connection field, select "uipathlabs@gmail.com". In the Activity dropdown, select "Send Email".
